purpose: Multidimensional Quality Metrics-inspired error taxonomy used by the QA scorer. Weights follow MQM-style severity multipliers applied to errors per 1000 words.

acceptance.gate: pass requires score >= pass_score AND zero critical errors

notes.scoring_note: Score = 100 - sum(weight * errors_per_1000_words). One critical error in 1000 words = -25 points and fails the gate regardless of arithmetic. Reviewers assign severity; the tool applies it consistently.
notes.evidence: MQM (http://themqm.org, CC-BY) inspired; weights are project-adjustable by editing this file.
